# Summary
A bug where `disabled: this.disableButton` passed a method reference that lost `this` context, causing `bizState` checks to fail and making single-row delete clickable in non-pending states. Fixed by adding a `canOperate` computed property in `houseTable.vue` (checking `bizState == 0 || bizState == '0'`) and binding delete via arrow functions `disabled: () => !this.canOperate` and `visible: () => this.canOperate`.

# Summary
Both the `/index` static route and `flowable/todo` interface route set `affix: true`, and `TagsView` additionally pinned `path === 'index'`, causing duplicate pinned todo-task tags. Fixed by removing the static `/index` affix in `permission.js` and adjusting `filterAffixTags` to pin only one tag matching `homeRoutePath`, deleting the `path === 'index'` special case.

# Summary
The B-end hid the left 'property management area' selector but `complexId` was not auto-bound from `$store.getters.currentProjectId`, causing 'add' validation to fail. Fixed by adding `resolveComplexFromProject()` in `facility/index.vue` to auto-fill `complexId`/`complexName` from the top nav, called in `init` and `handleAdd`, and optimizing B-end prompt text.
